cards.style: Flat surface, no soft shadows, 1px solid border (#27272A), sharp or slightly rounded corners (borderRadius: 8px).
cards.hover_active_state: Slight scale down (0.98) on press via reanimated, border color shifts to #71717A.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (borderRadius: 9999px), Background: #D4FF00, Text: #000000 (Oswald, Uppercase). No shadow, flat and tactical.

headers.style: Glassmorphism. Do not use pure transparent! Use expo-blur with intensity 80, tint 'dark', and a 1px bottom border (#27272A).

badges.pr: Use expo-linear-gradient (Gold/Volt), Black text, uppercase micro typography.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use $4 (16px) for inner card padding, $6 (24px) for screen margins. Vertical gaps between sections should be $8 (32px).
layouts.home_screen: Hero header overlapping content. High-density 'Bento' grid for stats (total workouts, kg lifted).
layouts.workout_session: Dense, scan-able list. Every pixel utilized. Rows for Sets/Reps/Weight with distinct column alignment.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for fixed headers/bottom tabs (via expo-blur).
visual_enhancers.lines_and_grid: Grid borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Dashboards/stats should feel like a command center.
visual_enhancers.borders: Tactical Minimalism. Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight upward slide (reanimated).
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale to 0.95 on press. Success states trigger a quick color flash (white to Volt).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Volt accent (#D4FF00) has pure black text for readability. APCA contrast compliant.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements (calendar days, checkboxes).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="start-workout-btn"`).

image_urls.description: Athletic man working out in a modern gym. Use with heavy dark gradient overlay.
Close up photo of a turned-on device/tracking.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a Tamagui + React Native Expo project. Map the HEX colors provided into the Tamagui theme configuration or create a custom palette.
Do NOT output generic HTML/CSS. Use Tamagui primitives (Stack, XStack, YStack, Text, Button) or React Native elements.
Implement The Performance Pro archetype: Deep Obsidian (#09090B) base, Pure White (#FFFFFF) text, and Volt Lime (#D4FF00) as the kinetic trigger.
Use 'expo-linear-gradient' for PR badges and 'expo-blur' for sticky headers/bottom tabs.
Typography: Use a condensed uppercase font (e.g., Oswald or Anton) for headers and numbers, and a geometric sans (e.g., Manrope) for body text. Load these via @expo-google-fonts.
For the Calendar, do not use native 'input date'. Build a grid using Tamagui stacks or a reliable RN calendar library, customized heavily to match the flat, 1px-border aesthetic.
Do not use generic 'orange' or 'purple'. Stick strictly to the Obsidian/White/Volt palette.
Use `data-testid` on all buttons, touchables, and inputs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use purely transparent backgrounds on elements overlapping content (headers, bottom tabs, modals). Always use a solid color or a blur layer.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use left-aligned, asymmetrical 'tactical' layouts with strong grids.
Use layered design elements: 1px borders instead of soft shadows to create depth.
Create distinctive interfaces: surprise and delight with micro-animations on press via react-native-reanimated.
Do not use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use proper SVG icon libraries (lucide-react-native).
Missing images must be handled with the provided image_urls, NO placeholder text.
